question: Who among the following is NOT a tabla player?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pannalal Ghosh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pannalal Ghosh** was a renowned **flautist** and not a tabla player.
 
• He is known for his exceptional skill in playing the **bansuri** (Indian bamboo flute).
 
• **Pannalal Ghosh** is credited with introducing the **longer bansuri** to Indian classical music, which allowed for a greater range of notes.
 
• He was a pioneering figure in the field of **Hindustani classical music**, and his contributions have had a lasting impact.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sabir Khan**__

 __
 
• **Sabir Khan** is an accomplished **tabla player** from India.
 
• He has performed with many renowned artists and is known for his **skill and expertise** on the tabla.
 
 
 
• **Zakir Hussain**__
 __
 
• **Zakir Hussain** is one of the most famous **tabla players** in the world.
 
• He is known for his **virtuosity and innovation** in tabla playing.
 
 
 
• **Sandeep Das**__
 
 
• **Sandeep Das** is a renowned **tabla player** who has collaborated with various international musicians.
 
• He is a recipient of several **prestigious awards** for his contributions to music.
